states: Private DEMO_MODE mock stack (demo/demo, PULSE_TELEMETRY=false) serving an embedded production build of this tree on base bdf0f76b7b, plus a before build of unmodified main on a second port for comparison; headless Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844.

Patrol Inbox renders unchanged at both widths: Watch only mode row, Check now and Settings, Inbox/Protection/Activity tabs, the 7-decision inbox with Start review, Review 1 approval and Refresh. No console errors after the change.

Before: one GET /api/ai/intelligence/correlations per initial Patrol load, browser reload, 60 s poll tick and tab hide/show at both widths. After: zero in every phase. Every other /api/ai/* read in each phase is identical before and after.

Not covered in the browser: the Patrol could not refresh banner's Retry path, which every Patrol read swallows so it cannot be forced from the network; it calls the same background reader edited here and is covered by unit tests.

Repeated the load, reload and tab hide/show phases on the final rebased build at both widths and inspected the screenshots.
